name: Tonemap on channel 0 only (Reinhard, Möbius, ACES-like)
plain: Same white-point recipe as core but applied only to channel 0, treated as luminance, with a choice of three curves. On a one-channel slice the vector norm is just |x|, so the sign is kept and the magnitude is compressed. Treating channel 0 as luminance is the pack's assumption.
math:
L=x[:,0:1], m=|L|+1e−10, top=(5·std(m)+mean(m))·multiplier, t=m/top
reinhard: t/(t+1)
mobius: t(1+t)/(1+t²)
aces: t(t+0.45)/(t²+0.91t+0.91)
L′ = (L/m)·curve·top, other channels unchanged
